title: lswu-lightweight-lswu
label: "Farmboy" Clement Tyme

won.source: The promotion's own debut broadcast, 3 December 1999: after ruling the scheduled title match a no-contest, President Ben Tuckwell awarded the vacant Lightweight Championship to Clement Tyme by decree.

note: Confirmed still champion the following night, entering the Southwestern Championship battle royal as the reigning Lightweight Champion.

title: lswu-southwestern-lswu
label: "Maniac" David Rage

won.source: The promotion's own second broadcast, 4 December 1999: David Rage eliminated Lord Bradbury, Clement Tyme and Thomas Rainka to win a battle royal for the vacant Southwestern Championship.

note: Immediately challenged by a debuting newcomer, CJ Bender, who attacked the new champion and was booked into a three-way title match the following week; no document of that show survives in the held record.
